_comment: Copy this file to config.json (same folder as launcher.py) and edit. All keys are optional; anything omitted uses the built-in defaults.
_server_host: Fixed CompuOffice server name or IP, e.g. 'OFFICE-PC' or '192.168.1.50'. Leave empty to auto-discover on the LAN, then fall back to localhost.
_server_port: HTTP port the CompuOffice server serves its UI on (the Windows COServerPort). Set this to match your server.
_ports_comment: UDP ports used for LAN discovery. The Windows launcher reads these from the CompuOffice install (SYSCOPort / ColCoPort / BroadCastPort). If discovery does not find your server, either set server_host directly or match these to your server.
